'''Luthik Uwyr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|dark side adept]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, well, it seems an initiate comes upon me so brazen. I feel great anger within you, yes I do. Let me see how you choose to channel that fire.|Luthik Uwyr, to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].|<ref name="SWG:LU" />}}
In about [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Uwyr traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. Uwyr sensed great anger in the spacer, so sent the individual to kill a [[voritor lizard]]. The individual was successful and afterwards, Uwyr sent the spacer to deliver a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], then to [[Death/Legends|kill]] an untrained [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="SWG:LU" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Luthik Uwyr appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> However, Uwyr was removed from the game in [[2006]].
